mapper.sql: upload_id,tenant_id,uploader_id,source_system,reason_code,display_name,expected_size,expected_mime, storage_provider,storage_container_ref AS container_ref,storage_object_ref AS object_ref, scan_policy_id,expires_time AS expires_at,status,access_level,replaces_file_id,replacement_no,base_object_version
mapper.select: SELECT p.policy_id,p.rule_schema_version,p.allowed_mime_rules,p.max_size_bytes, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_file_scan_requirement r WHERE r.policy_id=p.policy_id) AS requirement_count FROM t_file_scan_policy p WHERE p.policy_code=#{code} AND p.status='ACTIVE' AND p.active_slot=1 AND (p.effective_from IS NULL OR p.effective_from <= #{now}) AND (p.effective_to IS NULL OR p.effective_to > #{now})
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_file_upload WHERE replaces_file_id=#{fileId} AND status IN ('CREATED','UPLOADING') AND expires_time > #{now}
SELECT COALESCE(MAX(replacement_no),0) FROM t_file_upload WHERE replaces_file_id=#{fileId}
mapper.update: UPDATE t_file_upload SET status='CANCELLED',version=version+1,update_time=#{now} WHERE upload_id=#{id} AND status IN ('CREATED','UPLOADING')
